card.name: Small words before cardiac channel terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (like "e.g.,", "a", "of", "with") just before cardiac terms such as calcium channel blocker, QT interval, or sodium channelopathies.

modes.label: After e.g.
modes.description: The comma-period after "e.g" that introduces a cardiac condition or QT-related example.

modes.label: Before calcium channel blocker
modes.description: A small word such as "a" or "another" right before a calcium channel blocker or dihydropyridine.
modes.example: a beta blocker and<< a>> calcium channel blocker

modes.label: Before QT or angina wording
modes.description: A linking word like "of" or "with" ahead of a prolonged QT interval or a drug causing angina.
modes.example: in the setting<< of>> a prolonged QT interval

card.writes: It seems to push toward engineering words like cable, motors and cos and away from unrelated tokens, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words just before heart-rhythm and calcium channel blocker terms.
